dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, germinal-center B-cell type by Hans algorithm (CD10+, MUM1/IRF4 negative), newly diagnosed and untreated.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: Extranodal disease: right renal cortical lesion 3.2 cm (SUVmax 19.6), left adrenal 2.6 cm (SUVmax 17.2), hepatic segment VI 1.8 cm (SUVmax 15.0).

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: unintentional weight loss 79 to 70.2 kg (about 11% in about 2 months) and drenching night sweats

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: The liver lesion has not been biopsied. If it were not lymphoma, the stage would be III-B. Treatment is the same either way.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor status is negative by IHC: MYC 20% (threshold 40%) and BCL2 30% (threshold 50%). FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor status is negative by IHC: MYC 20% (threshold 40%) and BCL2 30% (threshold 50%).

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5 (age >60, LDH >ULN, ECOG >=2, stage IV, more than one extranodal site) is high risk; IPI 4 would still be high risk even if ECOG is 1.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI high: age >60, LDH >ULN, ECOG >=2, stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney and adrenal involvement (all six factors present; high-risk group is 4 or more points).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Full-dose curative-intent immunochemotherapy: pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin replaces vincristine in R-CHOP), 21-day cycles, 6 cycles, with CNS prophylaxis and primary G-CSF prophylaxis.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: pola-R-CHP is a standard first-line option for IPI 2-5 per POLARIX. Fallback if polatuzumab is not approved or covered: R-CHOP-21 x6

mn_non_curative.quote: Treatment intent is curative, but this is high-risk disease.

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not chosen: high-dose methotrexate, because eGFR is about 50 and falling and renal clearance is not reliable enough; dose-adjusted EPOCH-R, because there is no double-hit biology

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: reduced-intensity regimens, because he is fit enough for full dose

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High risk of CNS relapse. CNS-IPI high: age >60, LDH >ULN, ECOG >=2, stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney and adrenal involvement (all six factors present; high-risk group is 4 or more points).

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: Before the first dose: brain MRI with and without gadolinium (a group II agent is acceptable at eGFR 50) and LP with cell count, cytology, flow cytometry, protein and glucose.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: Why intrathecal rather than high-dose methotrexate: high-dose methotrexate needs reliable renal clearance; his eGFR is 50 and declining, with recent NSAID exposure and an ACE inhibitor, so the nephrotoxicity risk is too high.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: Not chosen: high-dose methotrexate, because eGFR is about 50 and falling and renal clearance is not reliable enough

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT about 4-6 weeks after cycle 6 (about late January to early February 2027), read by Lugano 2014 criteria: complete metabolic response = Deauville 1-3 with no new lesions

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Residual PET-avid retroperitoneal disease at end of treatment: consolidative involved-site radiotherapy (about 30-36 Gy) to the bulky site, and biopsy if the residual uptake is high or new.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Admit for cycle 1 from day -1 to day 3 for IV hydration (target urine output at least 100 mL/m2/h, watching volume given grade I diastolic dysfunction and EF 60%), electrolytes every 8-12 hours, and no potassium supplements.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: Send G6PD now. If G6PD is normal, give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV once before chemotherapy (day -1 or day 1).

sup_gcsf.quote: primary pegfilgrastim prophylaxis each cycle (age 65 or older, ECOG 2, renal impairment, diabetes; febrile neutropenia risk above 20%)

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen today and avoid all NSAIDs. Scheduled acetaminophen 650 mg PO every 6 hours (maximum 3 g/day) for pain.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Diabetes with steroid-induced hyperglycemia: glucose before meals and at bedtime during prednisone days; basal plus correction insulin or NPH with prednisone; target 140-180 mg/dL

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive. No HBV prophylaxis and no HBV DNA monitoring needed for rituximab.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Cardiac: baseline LVEF 60% with GLS -19%; cumulative doxorubicin 300 mg/m2. Repeat echo only if symptoms or for institutional practice.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: he is fit enough for full-dose curative-intent immunochemotherapy with G-CSF and CNS prophylaxis; age 67 is not in itself a reason for dose reduction
